meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.
"The zero stands." On what basis, Hale, because your own procedure 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody did. Show me what you have, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:41.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.

Then show me both, the line and the outline, side by side. I'm writing down October 15. And students change their argument between an outline and a final draft, Hale, so what makes that a reason for a zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, with an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and I want to see the line you say is not in Hamlet and the October 15 outline. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, still demanding the zero be withdrawn, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: the October 15 outline, which got her writing it down and asking to see it, though not enough to shift her position.
